purpose: A single register of every claim AURA makes and the evidence behind it. A product may only be sold, and a claim may only be published, when the matching record is 'verified'. Missing evidence is recorded as missing, never implied.

statusMeaning.verified: Evidence held, checked against the exact product and edition, and in date. The claim may be published.
statusMeaning.pending: Evidence requested or expected but not yet received. No claim may be published.
statusMeaning.not-provided: The supplier or owner has not supplied this and no request is open. Treat as absent.
statusMeaning.not-applicable: This control does not apply to this product, with the reason recorded.

categories.product-safety: Safety assessment, hazard data, and any statutory product file.
categories.labelling: Mandatory label content, language, batch coding, and responsible-person details.
categories.claims: Substantiation for every efficacy or ingredient claim published on the site.
categories.lab-test: Third-party laboratory reports: composition, purity, contaminant, and microbiological testing.
categories.accreditation: Certificates from recognised bodies: organic, fair trade, GOTS, FSC, ISO, and similar.
categories.medical-report: Clinical or toxicological reports. Only relevant where a product makes a health claim; not a substitute for regulatory approval.
categories.origin: Traceability from supplier to declared country of manufacture.
categories.ethical: Supply-chain audits, animal-testing statements, and labour standards.
categories.food-safety: For any future food or edible item: composition, allergen, shelf-life, and labelling evidence.
categories.image-rights: Written permission to publish each supplied photograph.
